senses.sense_definition: An English surname derived from someone living near an apple orchard or gate.

examples.text: Professor <w>Applegate</w> published a fascinating new book on ancient history last week.
The delivery was addressed to a person named David <w>Applegate</w>.

senses.sense_definition: An unincorporated community in Placer County, California, United States.

examples.text: They drove through <w>Applegate</w> on their way to the mountains in California.
The quiet town of <w>Applegate</w> is known for its scenic views and pleasant weather.

senses.sense_definition: A village in Sanilac County, Michigan, United States.

examples.text: The post office in <w>Applegate</w> has been serving local residents for decades.
She grew up in <w>Applegate</w>, a small village located in eastern Michigan.

senses.sense_definition: An unincorporated community in Jackson County, Oregon, United States.

examples.text: The scenic valley around <w>Applegate</w> attracts many wine enthusiasts each year.
Several small farms thrive in <w>Applegate</w> due to the favorable climate.
